cell_status.duplicate: more than one usable row for the cell (not attributable to one final run)
cell_status.missing: a job line without a usable row: the aggregator's missing_reason (pending, not_launched, agent_crashed, sim_failure, no_metrics, code_mismatch, label_problem, health_only, ...)
cell_status.no_row: no job line of this cell in the input
cell_status.used: exactly one usable row (the final valid record whose code matches the pins), with valid_record = 1

finding_1.text: improves over fixed-depth and fixed-refresh methods (outline IV-A finding 1)

finding_2.text: action-aware scheduling uses compute better than Age-Only and Event-Triggered (outline IV-A finding 2)

H1.question: Full FrameLease achieves a higher DS than each of Fixed Deep, Fast Only, Age-Only and Event-Triggered at kappa 1.0 on the 44 test routes (Holm over 4)
H1.rule: each contrast: improves if the mean DS difference is > 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (Holm over 4), worse if < 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, otherwise inconclusive; finding 1 may be stated only if contrasts 1 and 2 are both improves, finding 2 only if contrasts 3 and 4 are both improves; mixed outcomes are reported as mixed (Sec. 9.2)

H2.question: key secondary: Full FrameLease achieves a higher DS than FrameLease + Heuristic (single test)
H2.rule: the RL benefit is claimed only if H2 is improves; with P_both < 0.05 in the kappa-1.0 episodes of the RL dataset the RL contribution is labelled "not testable at this operating point" and H2 is reported with that label (Secs. 5.8, 9.13)

H4_offline.label: inconclusive
H4_offline.rule: supported: the 95% CI of the continuity difference lies above 0 and the 95% CI of the realized-R_cond difference contains 0 or lies below 0; contradicted: the continuity CI lies below 0; inconclusive otherwise. Secondary rows use the same rule, with the difference oriented so that positive is better (premature refresh: B - A)
H4_offline.status: pre-specified in code, executed before registration (PROTOCOL Sec. 11.1 item 5: the offline analysis ran on 2026-11-10, before the registration; the Sec. 9.4 rule is applied here)

H5.label: contradicted
H5.rule: supported if the commit audit finds 0 commits violating Eq. 9 in every run of every phase and stress test S3 finds 0 violations; contradicted otherwise, with every violation listed (Sec. 9.5)
